source.test: resolvedActiveSlotID(forServerDir:) chain plus a Phase 6 file-by-file archive comparison — see docs/msc2/worlds/phase6-scope.md §"State 3 — both together", step 3, "Proven identical"

input.comparison_method: extract archive to scratch location, compare file-by-file: presence, size, and content hash

notes: phase6-scope.md State 3 (lines 61-69): live folders exist and world_slots/ resolves to a recorded active slot with a real archive. Equality must be proven, not assumed -- a cheap check that could produce a false 'identical' (matching only names or sizes) is explicitly disallowed (line 67) because a wrong 'equal' verdict is a silent data-loss bug, not a performance shortcut. When the file-by-file comparison genuinely proves identical, this is the common no-op case for a server that was cleanly stopped and never touched again: the active marker is persisted pointing at the existing recorded slot, and no new slot is created.
